newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB keeps discount at 1.0 pct after weekly meeting.
newsitem.headline: SNB keeps discount at 1.0 pct after weekly meeting.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said that it left its discount rate steady at 1.00 percent after a regular weekly meeting of its three-member board on Thursday.
"No change," an SNB spokesman said in response to an enquiry after the meeting ended.
The discount rate has been left at 1.00 percent since it was lowered from 1.50 percent on September 26, 1996.
Market participants generally had not expected any change in the rate at today's meeting. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
